```{=html}
<script>
// Send visitors to the post list in their language. A language chosen with the
// navbar switch wins; otherwise Japanese browsers go to /ja/, everyone else to /en/.
(function () {
  var lang = null;
  try { lang = localStorage.getItem('preferred-lang'); } catch (e) {}
  if (lang !== 'ja' && lang !== 'en') {
    var langs = navigator.languages || [navigator.language || ''];
    lang = String(langs[0] || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('ja') === 0 ? 'ja' : 'en';
  }
  location.replace(lang + '/');
})();
</script>
<noscript><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=en/"></noscript>
```
